title: Copilot Studio: service principal as owner of workflows
summary: The roadmap facts, application-user controls and corrected capacity-enforcement statements are supported. The billing open question incorrectly leaves the existing workflow meter's applicability unresolved: Microsoft's usage-based billing documentation covers workflows on the Microsoft Copilot harness without an ownership exclusion. Only a rule or rate specific to the new ownership option remains unpublished.
